meaning: The solution makes, routes, tiers or judges a language model call.
The solution bounds or causes spend in money, tokens, time, machine load or store size.
The solution takes, gates or reports an act that cannot be undone or that only a person should decide (spend, send, delete, change shared data).
The solution holds, moves or filters data that belongs to one person, team or quest, or keeps private data out of the public repository.
The solution decides text that goes into a model's prompt: instructions, context, frames or slices.
The solution reads, searches, applies or edits a project's ESOI records.
The solution runs, schedules or supervises work no person is watching.
The solution defines or documents what someone outside the project relies on: the public interface, configuration, command line, examples or documentation.
The solution measures, selects or checks parts of the project by metric, or checks the records themselves.
The solution keeps something a person said or a run learned and brings it back later.
The solution produces or delivers something a person reads: a reply, progress, a question, a channel message.
The solution reaches outside the process: the web, an external tool server, a vendor API, a host's data.
The solution reads or writes context cards by their fields, ids or store layout (docs/context-assembly.md, What a context card is), so it must change when that definition changes.
